evidence_spans: † Claude Opus 5.5, three runs per circuit.
CLM-EDA-0059.statement: On the Hard split of AMS-SizingBench, CRAFT with Claude Opus 5.5 achieves a mean runtime of 142.3 seconds.

extra_quotes: We test CRAFT on four circuits in a commercial 28 nm process; the largest is a 37-transistor three-stage amplifier with 53 design variables, 20 specifications and 74 saturation constraints.
